subject: fire mage in a crimson hooded robe holding a gnarled staff topped with an ember crystal
motion: a defensive flame shield: sweeping the staff in a full circle
facing: in a three-quarter view facing screen-right
effects: a ring of orange fire tracing the staff's circle

plan.source: Three-quarter facing right; left hand holds staff upright at screen-left, right hand extends to screen-right as if casting; hooded head turned right; feet wide, left forward, right back, both planted; relaxed weight centered.

frames.pose: Anticipation: torso leans back-right, hips dip; left hand draws staff back across body toward rear-right, tip low; right hand tucks near chest; head glances right; both feet planted, knees bent.
frames.effect: Small embers gather at crystal; faint spark trail starts behind tip low-right.

frames.pose: Key: sharp twist left; staff sweeps fast across front, mid-height to high-left; left arm extended, right arm swings back; torso forward-left, head follows arc; left foot braced, right planted.
frames.effect: Bright flame arc from low-right across front to high-left; thick leading arc with short trailing fire.

frames.pose: Follow-through: staff continues overhead to back-right; left elbow bends, tip passing above hood; torso counter-rotates, right hand opens outward; weight shifts to right leg, left planted.
frames.effect: Flame trail curves overhead to back-right, nearly closing the ring; sparks shed along the path.

frames.pose: Settle: staff comes down to near-upright at screen-left, slightly forward; torso untwists toward neutral; right hand re-extends forward; head centers; both feet reset, left leading.
frames.effect: Fading arc completes low-left segment to close the circle; thin lingering ring dissipates.
